integrity: Derivations are symbolic; fourteen cyclotomic arithmetic checks are corroborative finite instances, not exhaustive evidence for arbitrary graphs. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The all-graph inverse is exact but no general sharp conditioning law is proved. Additional binary graph cancellations are characterized through the independence polynomial, with a complete residue criterion only for paths. Historical priority, particularly broader simplicial Fourier minor theorems, is a residual risk.
title: Graph-exclusion Fourier interpolation: universal invertibility and a mod-four inverse resonance
